file_metadata.description: Complete procedural rubric for the Liturgy of Presanctified Gifts, including Lamb preparation, transfer of Holy Gifts, special censing, and communion rite. Covers concelebration with 1 deacon, 2 deacons, without deacon, and priestly concelebration.

preparation.when: Proskomedia of the preceding Sunday (or last Liturgy before Presanctified)

lamb_preparation.no_216: Besides the Lamb for that day, prepare additional Lambs for upcoming Presanctified services
lamb_preparation.arrangement: Place Lambs near one another on diskos

consecration.no_217: Say 'And make this Bread' in SINGULAR (not plural) — Christ is one
consecration.no_218: Elevate ALL consecrated Lambs simultaneously; break only the first; place IC part in chalice; pour warm water; store remaining Lambs in tabernacle pyx

sequence: Deacon brings diskos, star-cover, small veil to holy table
Priest kisses Gospel, moves it to right side of holy table
Places diskos on unfolded antimension (left side)
Opens tabernacle, makes small bow
Takes chalice with lid (containing Lamb), places on middle of antimension
Takes Presanctified Bread from pyx, places on diskos
Adds communion particles if needed (no. 230)
Returns pyx to tabernacle, closes it
Centers diskos on antimension, censes star-cover and veil
Covers diskos with small veil
Censes around holy table (deacon walks ahead with candle)
Makes prostrate bow with sign of cross
Takes covered diskos on head, processes to table of oblation (deacon ahead with candle and censer)

from_tabernacle_on_oblation_table.no_228: Same procedure but at table of oblation; no procession needed

sequence: Place diskos on unfolded antimension
Pour wine and water into chalice (saying nothing)
Cense veil of chalice, cover chalice with it
Cover diskos and chalice with large veil (aer)
Say only: 'Through the prayers of our holy fathers'
Make prostrate bow, return to holy table
Place Gospel on folded antimension

timing_option.no_229: Placing Lamb: during 1st Antiphon; censing: during 2nd; transfer: during 3rd

pre_liturgy.hours: Priest in epitrachelion stands before holy doors; Reader: 3rd, 6th, 9th Hours + Typika
pre_liturgy.vesting: At end of Typika: vest in sacred vestments saying only 'Let us pray to the Lord' for each

vespers_portion.opening: After Typika dismissal, holy doors opened; Priest: 'Wisdom'; regular dismissal
vespers_portion.second_opening: Three small bows before holy table; kisses; Deacon: 'Bless, Master'; Priest: 'Blessed is the kingdom'
vespers_portion.psalm_103: Reader: 'Come let us worship' x3 + opening psalm
vespers_portion.vespers_prayers: Priest reads Vespers prayers 4-8 (first three read later at Antiphons)
vespers_portion.kathisma_18: With Small Litanies; Vespers prayers 1-3 read during antiphons
vespers_portion.lord_i_have_cried: Deacon censes (censes Presanctified Gifts thrice, each with 3 swings)
vespers_portion.entrance: As usual; may be with Gospel if readings appointed

readings.paremia_1: Reader reads from ambo, facing east

light_of_christ.no_234: Priest takes candle + censer, faces east, makes sign of cross: 'Wisdom, arise'; turns to west: 'The Light of Christ illumines all'; ALL make 3 great prostrations

let_my_prayer.no_235: After completion of 2nd Paremia: Priest: 'Peace be to thee'; Deacon: 'Wisdom'

no_236.sequence: Priest censes holy table on 4 sides while singing 'Let my prayer be set forth' with Psalm 140 verses
no_236.censing_pattern: 3 swings at beginning and end of each verse
no_236.posture: Choir and faithful on knees during priest's singing; all kneel when choir sings; 3 bows at completion

readings_on_saint_day.no_237: If saint/temple feast: Prokimenon, Apostle, Gospel as prescribed

liturgy_portion.litanies: Let us all say + prayers for catechumens

from_mid_lent.no_239: From Wed of 4th week: also dismiss those preparing for baptism (illumination)

now_the_powers.no_240: Choir sings; deacon opens holy doors, censes front of throne + oblation table + priest; priest and deacon recite hymn x3 with small bows

great_entrance.no_241: Priest takes aer, places on deacon's left shoulder; takes diskos on head (right hand), chalice at chest (left hand)
great_entrance.no_242: If diskos has no foot: place diskos on covered chalice, hold veil over it with right hand
great_entrance.no_243: Exit through northern doors; NO ONE SAYS ANYTHING during procession; deacon censes frequently; enter through holy doors; place diskos on left of throne, chalice on right; cover with aer (censed); 3 great prostrations; close holy doors and curtain

communion.no_245: Priest does NOT uncover gifts; reaches under aer to touch Bread; 'The Presanctified Holy Things to the holy'
communion.no_246: Communion of Body as usual; deacon wipes chalice saying nothing
communion.distribution: Deacon shows chalice at holy doors: 'Draw near'; Choir: 'I will bless the Lord'; communion as at Chrysostom Liturgy; formula: 'The precious and most holy Body and Blood'

dismissal.no_247: Author NOT mentioned at dismissal; During Passion Mon-Wed: dismissal of Palm Sunday: 'Christ, our true God, who came to His voluntary Passion'

two_deacons.great_entrance: Both deacons cense frequently before priest
two_deacons.key_differences: Readings distributed between deacons; 1st deacon: 'Let us be attentive', 2nd deacon: 'Wisdom' etc.

without_deacon.rule: Priest exclaims everything belonging to deacon
without_deacon.server_assists: With lighted candle during censing, Let my prayer, Great Entrance

rules: Same as Vespers and Chrysostom concelebration
Vesting: say only 'Let us pray to the Lord' for each vestment
Reserved exclamations: 'For to Thee belongs', 'For a merciful', 'According to the gift', 'For Thou art our sanctification'
At 'Let my prayer': concelebrants step back when principal passes, kneel and rise together
Great Entrance: concelebrants carry nothing (1st may carry chalice before principal)
